notes.title: Radiant Victorias Confirmed for September 5th Release, with Character ASMR DLC!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758606/d6921a056c3b5528ae2a047b74ecda3c40a1cf8b.jpg

Dear Players,

Thank you for your patience. We're excited to announce that Radiant Victorias is officially set to launch on September 5th (PT)! Soon, you'll be able to embark on a thrilling and heart-pounding harem adventure with 8 divine goddesses ❤️

Additionally, we're pleased to reveal that the Radiant Victorias character ASMR albums featuring "Eleonora" and "Cindy" will also be available on Steam. These will be released as DLC alongside the main game, complete with subtitles in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese.

Stay tuned for the excitement to come!
